purpose: Add an end-to-end hierarchy-coupled rotational secondary-motion stage without weakening source safety or representing deterministic physics as learned animation.

supported_scope.topology: one unbranched chain of at least two selected pose controls whose selected members have direct parent-child relationships
supported_scope.channels: complete editable rotation curve groups on every selected control
supported_scope.location: ordinary independent selected-control location follow remains available, but chain coupling affects rotation only
supported_scope.priority_policy: the chain correction envelope is exactly zero at every captured priority pose
supported_scope.publication: copied candidate action with ordinary editable linear keys

nonclaims: No learned weights or learned secondary motion.
No automatic hair, cloth, tail, flesh or prop detection.
No world-space chain gravity or chain collision in this bounded stage.
No deformation-volume, self-collision or arbitrary-mesh solve.
No human quality conclusion or Cascadeur parity claim.
